name: the-network
description: Skills and MCP servers for the apps powered by The Network: ntwrk.party, slop.date (dating, adults only), peon.biz (work) and friends.help (friends in NYC, SF, LA, Chicago and Miami). Explains each app and helps the person sign themselves up: the person approves the profile in the conversation, and confirms their own phone and allows access in their own browser. Never handles phone numbers or verification codes.
